import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Search for 'ChatGPT' using the searchbox
    searchbox = page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Filter by name')
    await searchbox.fill('ChatGPT')
    await searchbox.press('Enter')
    
    # Wait for the page to update after search
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait to ensure content loads
    
    # Step 2: Click the link to the 'ChatGPT' project
    # Assuming the link appears with name containing 'ChatGPT'
    chatgpt_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='ChatGPT', exact=False)
    await chatgpt_link.click()
    
    # Wait for navigation to the project details page
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
